profile.name: Saif Chamakhi
profile.title: Unity Developer
profile.availability: Full-time or contract · Remote on EU/GMT hours
profile.intro: I build Unity gameplay systems, scalable UI, and multiplayer features for PC, mobile, and WebGL. Building games since 2019; working in professional studios since 2023.

projects.title: Maleficus
projects.kind: Multiplayer arena spell game. Refactored a coupled codebase into an event-driven architecture with strict UI/gameplay separation.
projects.role: Unity Developer · Gameplay architecture and UI
projects.summary: Reworked the multiplayer arena game's architecture and built its state-driven player onboarding and spell selection.
projects.challenge: The existing codebase tightly coupled UI and gameplay, making changes difficult to isolate as features grew.
approach: Refactored the codebase around events with a strict separation between UI and gameplay.
Built a state-driven flow for team, character, spell, and ready selection, with modular spell selection.
projects.outcome: Delivered the architecture refactor and onboarding flow. The project is complete and awaiting publisher release.
bullets: Refactored a tightly coupled codebase into an event-driven architecture with strict UI/gameplay separation.
Built the state-driven onboarding flow — team, character, spell, ready — and modular spell selection.
Project complete and awaiting publisher release.

projects.title: Tikto King
projects.kind: Multi-game platform with a Minimax + Alpha-Beta pruning AI for Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe.
projects.role: Unity Developer · Game AI and board systems
projects.summary: Built Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe AI and reusable board and turn systems for a platform that later added a quiz game.
projects.challenge: Support multiple AI difficulty tiers while keeping board state and turn management flexible enough to extend beyond one game.
approach: Implemented Minimax with Alpha-Beta pruning and multiple difficulty tiers for Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe.
Designed shared board-state and turn-management systems, then extended the platform to support Tikto and Quiz.
projects.outcome: The prototype was playtested at multiple events in Tunis, including Global Game Jam. Its board and turn systems supported the multi-game extension.
bullets: Built a Minimax + Alpha-Beta pruning AI for Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe with multiple difficulty tiers.
Designed shared board-state and turn-management systems, then extended the platform to support Tikto and Quiz.
Playtested at multiple events in Tunis, including Global Game Jam.

projects.title: The Amazing SaniBoy
projects.kind: Released mobile action game. Owned UI, gameplay mechanics, and backend integration; the game reached 100,000+ downloads.
projects.role: Game Developer · UI, gameplay and integrations
projects.summary: Owned UI, gameplay mechanics, and backend integration through the mobile action game's Google Play release.
projects.challenge: Bring the game's UI, gameplay mechanics, store data, and platform integrations together for a commercial Android launch.
approach: Built UI and gameplay mechanics, including loading screens, and supported level design.
Implemented the in-game store data layer and integrated Google Play services, ads, and leaderboards.
projects.outcome: Released on Google Play. The game reached 100,000+ downloads and a 4.7-star rating across 56 reviews.
bullets: Owned UI, gameplay mechanics, and backend integration through the Google Play release. The game reached 100,000+ downloads and a 4.7-star rating across 56 reviews.
Implemented the in-game store data layer and integrated Google Play services, ads, and leaderboards.
Built loading screens, supported level design, and led bug-fixing efforts through to launch.

projects.title: Draft Fever Bowl
projects.kind: Football management sim. Delivered the full UI layer inside a 20+ person production.
projects.summary: Delivered the football management game's UI layer in a production team of more than 20 people.
projects.challenge: Support the game's landing page, settings, live scoreboard, and popups with a responsive UI layer that other team members could reuse.
approach: Built the landing page, settings menu, live scoreboard, and a responsive popup framework.
Authored shared utility scripts and animation helpers for early-stage feature work across the team.
projects.outcome: Delivered the full UI layer and a popup framework reused across the team. The game has not released yet.
bullets: Delivered the full UI layer — landing page, settings menu, live scoreboard, and a responsive popup framework — within a 20+ person production.
Authored shared utility scripts and animation helpers that accelerated early-stage feature work across the team.

projects.title: The Plooshies
projects.kind: WebGL multiplayer party game. Photon Fusion netcode and in-browser performance work.
projects.summary: Integrated Photon Fusion multiplayer and improved UI performance and gameplay stability for a WebGL party game demo.
projects.challenge: Prepare multiplayer gameplay for an in-browser demo under a fixed deadline, with UI performance and gameplay bugs to resolve.
approach: Integrated Photon Fusion multiplayer and optimised the UI for WebGL performance.
Used live team testing to clear gameplay bugs and tune moment-to-moment feel before the demo deadline.
projects.outcome: Delivered multiplayer integration, UI performance work, and gameplay fixes for the demo. The project is unreleased.
bullets: Integrated Photon Fusion multiplayer and optimised UI for stable in-browser WebGL performance.
Cleared gameplay bugs and tuned moment-to-moment feel through live team testing against a hard demo deadline.

projects.title: Shells And Tails
projects.kind: Four-player split-screen showdown with four different rule sets.
projects.summary: Built four rule-set mini-games and connected split-screen cameras and local input for four players.
projects.challenge: Give each mini-game its own win condition and feel while supporting four players on one split-screen setup.
approach: Implemented the gameplay for each rule-set mini-game, including its distinct win condition.
Wired the split-screen camera rig and four-player local input handling.
projects.outcome: Implemented the mini-game rules and four-player split-screen setup. The project is unreleased.
bullets: Built the gameplay for each rule-set mini-game, each with its own win condition and feel.
Wired the split-screen camera rig and four-player local input handling.

projects.title: Albert's Ark Idle
projects.kind: 2D idle clicker. Core progression systems — experience, levelling, currency — through to release.
projects.summary: Built experience, levelling, and currency systems, contributed early UI, and supported stability work through Steam release.
projects.challenge: Implement the idle clicker's core progression systems and support the project through release with UI and stability work.
approach: Built the experience, levelling, and currency systems alongside early-stage UI.
Fixed bugs and improved stability through to release.
projects.outcome: Core progression systems and early UI shipped with the Steam release, supported by bug fixing and stability improvements.
bullets: Built core progression systems (experience, levelling, currency) and early-stage UI, plus bug fixing and stability improvements through to release.

tools.title: Texture & mesh compression tools
tools.description: Editor tools that reduce texture and mesh sizes across a project, helping control web and mobile build sizes without manual per-asset work.

tools.title: Adaptive UI system
tools.description: Generic framework that adapts to context — button count, field text, colour, width, and resolution — removing the need to rebuild interfaces per screen or platform.

earlierWork: Earlier titles include Slash And Dash (BPM-driven obstacle generation and background VFX) and DaQueen (ragdoll controller and Photon multiplayer), alongside a back catalogue of 20+ legacy titles restored and republished to current store requirements.
